SELECT A.RTU_ID, A.AREA_CODE, A.RTU_NAME, A.CALL_LAST, A.RTU_TYPE, D.GROUP_ID, D.GROUP_NAME, E.WR_EMD_CD, F.DONG, A.REAL_ORGAN_CODE,G.ORGAN_NAME, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', 1, 0)) AS RAIN, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', 1, 0)) AS FLOW, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='A', 1, 0)) AS ATMO, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='T', 1, 0)) AS TEMP, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='W', 1, 0)) AS WIND, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='H', 1, 0)) AS HUMI, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='R', 1, 0)) AS RADI, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='S', 1, 0)) AS SUNS, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL1, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL1, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL2, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL2, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL3, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL3
, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL4, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL4
, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL4, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL4, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL5, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL5
, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL1, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL1, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL2, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL2, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL3, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL3
, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL4, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL4
, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL4, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL4, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL5, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL5
FROM RTU_INFO AS A LEFT JOIN RTU_SENSOR AS B ON A.RTU_ID = B.RTU_ID LEFT JOIN DN_MAIN_MEMBER AS C ON A.RTU_ID = C.RTU_ID LEFT JOIN DN_MAIN_GROUP AS D ON C.GROUP_ID = D.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN RTU_LOCATION AS E ON A.RTU_ID = E.RTU_ID LEFT JOIN AREA_INFO AS F ON CONCAT(E.WR_EMD_CD,'00') = F.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN ORGAN_INFO AS G ON A.REAL_ORGAN_CODE = G.ORGAN_ID WHERE A.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id}
AND B.SENSOR_TYPE IN (#{w_sensertype})
AND A.RTU_TYPE IN ('B00','BR0','BA0','R00','RF0','RS0')
AND A.RTU_TYPE IN ('B00','BF0','BA0','F00','RF0')
AND A.RTU_TYPE = 'S00'
AND B.SENSOR_TYPE IN ('0','A','T','W','H','R','S') AND A.RTU_TYPE = 'A00'
AND B.SENSOR_TYPE = 'DP' AND A.RTU_TYPE = 'DP0'
AND D.GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY A.RTU_ID ORDER BY D.GROUP_ID
GROUP BY A.RTU_ID ORDER BY F.DONG ASC
GROUP BY A.RTU_ID
ORDER BY A.RTU_ID DESC

SELECT DISTINCT a.ORGAN_ID, a.AREA_CODE, a.RTU_ID ,a.RTU_NAME, b.SOLA_VOLT, b.SOLA_AMPERE, b.BATT_VOLT, b.LOAD1_AMPERE, b.LOAD2_AMPERE, b.LOGGER_STAT, b.DOOR_STAT, b.SENSOR_STAT, b.MAINAMP_STAT, b.AMP_POWER, b.AUDIO_VOLUME, b.SPEAKER_SELECT, b.LOG_DATE, IFNULL(d.AREA_CODE, '-') AS SMART_USE, IFNULL(d.SOLA_VOLT1, -99999) AS SOLA_VOLT1, IFNULL(d.SOLA_CURR1, -99999) AS SOLA_CURR1, IFNULL(d.SOLA_VOLT2, -99999) AS SOLA_VOLT2, IFNULL(d.SOLA_CURR2, -99999) AS SOLA_CURR2, IFNULL(d.BATT_VOLT1, -99999) AS BATT_VOLT1, IFNULL(d.BATT_VOLT2, -99999) AS BATT_VOLT2, IFNULL(d.LOAD_CURR1, -99999) AS LOAD_CURR1, IFNULL(d.LOAD_CURR2, -99999) AS LOAD_CURR2, IFNULL(d.LOAD_CURR3, -99999) AS LOAD_CURR3 FROM rtu_info AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM SMARTPOWER_HIST WHERE DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(LOG_DATE, '%Y%m%d') ORDER BY LOG_DATE DESC) AS TEMP GROUP BY TEMP.AREA_CODE ) AS d on a.AREA_CODE = d.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM STATE_HIST_NEW WHERE DATE_FORMAT(LOG_DATE, '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') ORDER BY LOG_DATE DESC) AS TMP GROUP BY TMP.AREA_CODE ) AS b ON a.AREA_CODE = b.AREA_CODE WHERE a.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id}

SELECT DISTINCT a.AREA_CODE ,a.RTU_ID, a.RTU_NAME, b.SPEAKER_USE1, b.SPEAKER_USE2, b.SPEAKER_USE3, b.SPEAKER_USE4, b.SPEAKER_USE5 , b.SPEAKER_USE6 , b.SPEAKER_USE7 , b.SPEAKER_USE8, c.SPEAKER1,c.SPEAKER2,c.SPEAKER3,c.SPEAKER4,c.SPEAKER5,c.SPEAKER6,c.SPEAKER7,c.SPEAKER8 FROM rtu_info AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM RTU_SPEAKER_USE ORDER BY UPDATE_TIME DESC) AS TMP GROUP BY TMP.RTU_ID) AS b ON a.RTU_ID = b.RTU_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM RTU_SPEAKER_STATUS ORDER BY LOG_NO DESC) AS tmp1 GROUP BY tmp1.RTU_ID) AS c ON a.RTU_ID = c.RTU_ID WHERE a.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id} AND a.AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT a.GROUP_ID, COUNT(b.RTU_ID) RTU_CNT, a.GROUP_NAME, a.ORGAN_ID FROM group_info AS a LEFT JOIN rtu_group AS b ON a.GROUP_ID = b.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN rtu_info AS c ON b.RTU_ID = c.RTU_ID WHERE c.RTU_TYPE IN ('B00', 'BD0','BR0','BF0','BA0') AND c.RTU_ID IS NOT NULL
AND c.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id}
AND c.RTU_ID IN (#{is_rtu_id})
GROUP BY a.GROUP_ID ORDER BY a.GROUP_ID

SELECT a.GROUP_ID, c.RTU_ID, c.RTU_NAME, c.SORT_FLAG, c.MODEL_NO FROM group_info AS a LEFT JOIN rtu_group AS b ON a.GROUP_ID = b.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN rtu_info AS c ON b.RTU_ID = c.RTU_ID WHERE c.RTU_TYPE IN ('B00', 'BD0','BR0','BF0','BA0') AND c.RTU_ID IS NOT NULL
AND c.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id}
AND c.RTU_ID IN (#{is_rtu_id})
ORDER BY a.GROUP_ID, c.SORT_FLAG

SELECT RTU_ID , AREA_CODE , COMBI_TYPE , RTU_TYPE , ORGAN_ID , SIGNAL_ID , RTU_NAME , LINE_NO , MODEL_NO , CONNECTION_INFO , PORT , BAUDRATE , SORT_FLAG , RTU_STATE , AMP_STATE , EQUIP_SEQ , LTE_CONNECTION , CALL_LAST , EVENT_QTAIL , WARNING_SMS , DANGER_SMS , REG_DATE , VHF_USE , VHF_SYSTEM_ID , VHF_RTU_ID , VHF_TRANS_ID , BROADCAST_SETTING , PRIORITY , SMARTPOWER , DSCODE , CD_DIST_OBSV , GB_OBSY , REAL_ORGAN_CODE FROM rtu_info
